capabilities: Display a customizable dashboard homepage with draggable, collapsible cards
Manage tasks and seven quick notes in synced Markdown files
Open or create daily notes from a built-in calendar
Track time on projects and tasks with sessions, budgets and CSV, Excel or PDF reports
Show optional cards for vault stats, a link graph, web clips, xkcd comics and Pebble ring notes
extras: Targets WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility with a documented gaps section; includes a full table of every network service and what it sends; most optional cards (time tracker, graph, xkcd, ring notes) are off by default and must be enabled in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in landing page that gathers daily tools like tasks, quick notes, daily notes and vault overview in one place.
